name: pumi-deno
description: Deno as a UI theme, after the Rex app: one quiet graphite window, the views down the side on dark tiles, each pane a bevelled card.

opacity.label: Background opacity
opacity.desc: How much of the desktop the window hides: 100 is opaque, lower lets it show through.

blur.label: Background blur
blur.desc: How much what shows through the window is blurred. Nothing at 100% opacity.

pane_titles.label: Show pane title bars
pane_titles.desc: A bar over each pane with its name and buttons, to drag it by. Off, only a pane of several tabs keeps one.

pane_outline.label: Outline the focused pane
pane_outline.desc: An accent edge on the pane with the focus while its view is split.

pane_equalize.label: Even out splits automatically
pane_equalize.desc: Every pane in a view gets an equal share as one opens or closes.

focus_follows_mouse.label: Focus the pane under the mouse
focus_follows_mouse.desc: A pane takes the focus as the mouse moves onto it, without a click.

sidebar_swipe.label: Hide the side bar with a swipe
sidebar_swipe.desc: Two fingers swept left over the side bar hide it; ⌘B brings it back.

view_icons.label: Tab icons per view
view_icons.desc: How many cards a view's tile stacks for its tabs (a deck behind the front one); 0 hides the tiles.

animate.label: Animate layout changes
animate.desc: Panes glide into place as they open, close, move and zoom.

haptics.label: Haptic feedback
haptics.desc: A tap on a Force Touch trackpad as a switch turns or a slider steps. Nothing on a mouse.
